visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man on a large indoor stadium LED screen is shown in a medium close-up, wearing a dark formal suit and white shirt; he waves his arms with grand, rhythmic conducting gestures as if leading an orchestra. (2) The camera transitions to a wide-angle shot of a massive darkened arena filled with thousands of spectators holding glowing red light sticks, which they wave in synchrony with the conductor's movements. (3) A woman on a brightly lit stage is visible, wearing a colorful floral-patterned robe and a red headscarf; she holds a microphone and points towards the crowd while several young men in red shirts cheer behind her. (4) The video concludes with a rapid-fire editing sequence alternating between close-ups of the woman shouting and wide shots of the stadium crowd raising their hands, accompanied by large white text banners appearing in the center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a massive crowd singing a wordless, melodic chant in unison over a driving high-tempo electronic dance beat with heavy synth bass. (2) A female speaker's voice pierces through the chanting with a sharp, high-intensity vocal burst, shouting a slogan into a microphone with significant stadium reverb. (3) The crowd responds instantly with a unified rhythmic shout of the player's name, 'Lin Zhi-sheng', matching the tempo of the background EDM track. (4) This call-and-response pattern repeats several times with escalating energy, characterized by high vocal arousal from both the leader and the crowd, layered over a consistent 4/4 electronic drum sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the high-energy atmosphere of a stadium cheer for Taiwanese baseball legend Lin Zhi-sheng, emphasizing the fan connection and the unique 'conductor' performance by the player himself on screen.
